# authwise_users (Data Source)

A user in a realm. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `realm_id` (String) Parent identifier `realm_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Every user under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))
